title: 上班日常
description: 辦公室日常工作的常用對話

sentences.en: Before I start working on the quarterly report, I need to check the emails that accumulated over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 在我開始處理季度報告之前，我需要查看週末累積的電子郵件。

sentences.en: The printer on the third floor, which was repaired last week, has broken down again due to a paper jam.
sentences.zh: 三樓那台上週才修好的印表機，又因為卡紙再次故障了。

sentences.en: Could you remind me to submit the expense report, which is due by the end of this week, to the finance department?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我在這週結束前把費用報告交給財務部嗎？

sentences.en: Having finished the morning standup meeting, I immediately began prioritizing the tasks assigned to me yesterday.
sentences.zh: 結束早上的站立會議後，我立刻開始排定昨天分配給我的工作優先順序。

sentences.en: The new office policy, announced by the HR director this morning, requires all employees to badge in before nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 今天早上人資主管宣布的新辦公室政策，要求所有員工在九點前刷卡進入。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could forward me the meeting minutes that were distributed during my absence last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 如果你能把上週四我不在時發的會議紀錄轉寄給我，我會很感激。

sentences.en: Since the air conditioning system is being serviced today, we have been advised to dress casually and stay hydrated.
sentences.zh: 由於空調系統今天正在維修，我們被建議穿著輕便並多喝水。

sentences.en: The intern, who joined our team two weeks ago, has already demonstrated remarkable proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
sentences.zh: 兩週前加入我們團隊的實習生，已經展現出在數據分析和報告方面出色的能力。

sentences.en: To ensure that the project stays on track, I have scheduled a brief check-in with each team member every Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 為了確保專案按進度進行，我安排了每週一早上與每位團隊成員的簡短確認會議。

sentences.en: Although the deadline was extended by two days, I still plan to complete my portion of the work by the original due date.
sentences.zh: 雖然截止日期延長了兩天，我仍然計劃在原定的到期日前完成我負責的部分。

sentences.en: The supply closet, located at the end of the hallway near the break room, has been restocked with printer paper and toner cartridges.
sentences.zh: 位於走廊盡頭休息室旁邊的辦公用品儲藏室，已經補充了列印紙和碳粉匣。

sentences.en: Before leaving for the day, please make sure to lock your computer and secure any confidential documents on your desk.
sentences.zh: 下班離開前，請確保鎖定你的電腦並妥善保管桌上的機密文件。

sentences.en: Having been promoted to team lead last month, she is now responsible for coordinating tasks and mentoring junior staff members.
sentences.zh: 上個月升任組長後，她現在負責協調任務和指導資淺員工。

sentences.en: The coffee machine in the kitchen, which everyone relies on during early mornings, needs to be descaled according to the maintenance schedule.
sentences.zh: 廚房裡那台大家早上都依賴的咖啡機，需要按照維護排程進行除垢。

sentences.en: I was unable to access the shared drive this morning because the network administrator was performing routine maintenance on the server.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上無法存取共用磁碟，因為網路管理員正在對伺服器進行例行維護。

sentences.en: Would it be possible for you to cover my shift on Friday afternoon, as I have a medical appointment that cannot be rescheduled?
sentences.zh: 你能替我代週五下午的班嗎？因為我有一個無法改期的醫療預約。

sentences.en: The ergonomic assessment, conducted by an external specialist last Tuesday, recommended that several workstations be adjusted for better posture.
sentences.zh: 上週二由外部專家進行的人體工學評估，建議調整幾個工作站以改善姿勢。

sentences.en: Given that the elevator is out of service until further notice, all employees are encouraged to use the stairwell near the lobby.
sentences.zh: 鑑於電梯在另行通知前停止服務，建議所有員工使用大廳旁邊的樓梯間。

sentences.en: After reviewing the updated attendance policy, I realized that we are now required to log our working hours through the new portal.
sentences.zh: 在查看更新後的出勤政策後，我意識到我們現在需要透過新的入口網站記錄工時。

sentences.en: The team lunch, organized by our department head to celebrate the successful product launch, will be held at the Italian restaurant downtown.
sentences.zh: 部門主管為慶祝產品成功上市而組織的團隊午餐，將在市中心的義大利餐廳舉行。

sentences.en: Since the renovation of the conference rooms is expected to last three weeks, we will need to book alternative spaces for our meetings.
sentences.zh: 由於會議室的翻新預計持續三週，我們需要預訂其他場地來開會。

sentences.en: I noticed that the task management system, which was recently upgraded to a newer version, now includes a feature for tracking time spent on each task.
sentences.zh: 我注意到最近升級到新版本的任務管理系統，現在包含了追蹤每個任務所花時間的功能。

sentences.en: The receptionist asked me to inform you that a package, delivered by courier this afternoon, is waiting for you at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 接待員請我通知你，今天下午快遞送來的一個包裹正在前台等你領取。

sentences.en: In order to maintain a productive work environment, management has decided to implement a quiet hours policy between two and four in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 為了維持有生產力的工作環境，管理層決定在下午兩點到四點之間實施安靜時段政策。

sentences.en: While I was organizing the files in the archive room, I discovered several important documents that had been misfiled under the wrong category.
sentences.zh: 當我在檔案室整理文件時，我發現幾份重要文件被錯誤歸類到了錯誤的類別下。

sentences.en: The building management has announced that the parking garage, which is currently at full capacity, will be expanded by adding fifty new spaces next quarter.
sentences.zh: 大樓管理處宣布，目前已滿的停車場將在下一季擴建增加五十個新車位。

sentences.en: If you encounter any technical issues with the new software that was installed yesterday, please submit a ticket through the IT helpdesk portal.
sentences.zh: 如果你在使用昨天安裝的新軟體時遇到任何技術問題，請透過 IT 服務台入口提交工單。

sentences.en: My supervisor suggested that I enroll in the leadership development program, which is designed for employees who have been with the company for over two years.
sentences.zh: 我的主管建議我報名參加領導力發展計畫，該計畫是為在公司服務超過兩年的員工設計的。

sentences.en: Considering that our department has exceeded its quarterly targets, the director has approved a team-building outing scheduled for next Friday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 考慮到我們部門已經超額完成季度目標，主管已批准安排在下週五下午的團隊建設活動。

sentences.en: The updated seating arrangement, which takes effect starting next Monday, was designed to improve cross-functional collaboration among different teams.
sentences.zh: 從下週一開始生效的新座位安排，是為了促進不同團隊之間的跨職能合作而設計的。
